records.narrative_summary: On Oct 14 at 02:14 UTC, threat actors bypassed perimeter defenses using an unpreventable zero-day exploit on the hospital Ivanti Connect Secure VPN concentrator (CVE-2023-46805). All MFA warranties and backup controls were fully active at the time of intrusion.

On Oct 15 at 11:30 UTC, attackers compromised an endpoint via a browser WebP exploit (CVE-2023-4863) after the user completed a valid MFA push challenge. Immutable backups remained intact and were used to restore operations.

Ransomware detonation occurred on Oct 16 at 04:00 UTC. The insured states all MFA policies were active, though some domain controller logs from the preceding evening were unavailable due to storage rotation.
